    a = parameters[0]    # y-intercept
    b1 = parameters[1]    # linear coefficient for drain voltage
    b2 = parameters[2]    # quadratic coefficient for drain voltage
    c = parameters[3]    # linear coefficient for gate voltage
    d = parameters[4]    # quadratic coefficient for gate voltage
    e = parameters[5]    # cubic coefficient for gate voltage
